data.animaCaption: Sweeping her long black hair forward over one shoulder so the bare spine of her sleeveless black backless knit catches the firelight, she turns back from the low leather ottoman with a crimson blush. Warm orange embers from the hearth sculpt her silhouette against the deep winter cabin dark.
data.promptProse: Viewed from a three-quarter rear angle beside a roaring stone hearth in a quiet winter safehouse, Shiki Natsume perches sideways on a low leather ottoman wearing a fitted sleeveless black turtleneck sweater cut entirely open down the back and sides, paired with a slender ribbon choker. She sweeps her dark hair forward over one shoulder, exposing her slender bare back and subtle sideboob as she glances back toward the viewer with a flustered flush that melts her usual cool armor under rich amber firelight.
data.story: 壁炉里的松木噼啪作响，把整间木屋烤得暖意融融。夏目背对炉火坐在矮皮凳上，把长发拢到一侧肩头，黑色露背针织勾出流畅的脊线；听见你脚步停住，她耳根泛红地回过头——「不是你挑的衣服吗？现在才脸红也太晚了。」
